place_convention_settled.decision: Country as the SHORT form (UK, USA), then nation, then place, comma-separated.
place_convention_settled.evidence: Measured over the live graph rather than chosen: USA 463 nodes, UK 29 against United Kingdom 14. 'UK, England, X' is the dominant second level at 22 nodes, with an optional county ('UK, England, Shropshire, RAF Shawbury').
place_convention_settled.so: Rendlesham Forest is 'UK, England, Rendlesham Forest', matching its neighbours RAF Woodbridge, RAF Bentwaters and RAF Lakenheath.

UK, England, Rendlesham Forest.confirmed: all three held claims about the same December 1980 Suffolk site - Halt's patrol, Penniston and Burroughs, the joint UK-US facility

warnings.washington_convention: Three spellings of the District are in use - 'USA, District of Columbia, X' (61 claims), 'USA, Washington DC, X' (57), 'USA, Washington, D.C.' (now merged). The city duplicates are merged; the sub-place PREFIXES are not normalised. Recommend 'District of Columbia' because it cannot collide with Washington State, which the graph also holds.
